title: Custom Sequence: Fibonacci
hints: A `Sequence` only needs `makeIterator()`; the iterator's `next()` produces values.
Keep `a` and `b` in the iterator; return `a` and advance. Use `.lazy` before filtering an infinite sequence.
`defer { (a, b) = (b, a &+ b) }; return a` inside `next()`.
jsBridge: Conforming to `Sequence` with an `IteratorProtocol` is JS's `[Symbol.iterator]()` returning `{ next() }`. Swift's iterator returns `Element?` (`nil` ends it) instead of `{done, value}`, and `lazy` gives you JS generator-style pipelines.

compass.q: JS generators (`function*`) make infinite sequences easy. What's the Swift equivalent (`sequence(first:next:)`, `AnyIterator`)?
